trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: State the intent to set up an instalment plan and provide the application ID.
steps.text: मला माझी semester fee instalments मध्ये pay करायची आहे. माझा application ID APP-2001 आहे.
steps.clean_text: मला माझी semester fee instalments मध्ये pay करायची आहे. माझा application ID APP-2001 आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: मला माझी semester fee instalments मध्ये pay करायची आहे. माझा application ID APP-2001 आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for identity verification factors before accessing or modifying the fee account.
steps.text: नमस्कार. मी नक्कीच मदत करतो. Security साठी, तुम्ही तुमचं registered name आणि date of birth सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity must be verified before proceeding with account-specific actions.

steps.text: माझं नाव Rohan आहे. Date of birth पेक्षा माझा registered pincode घ्या, तो 411038 आहे.
steps.clean_text: माझं नाव Rohan आहे. Date of birth पेक्षा माझा registered pincode घ्या, तो 411038 आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: माझं नाव Rohan आहे. Date of birth पेक्षा माझा registered pincode घ्या, तो 411038 आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the application ID and the factors the user provided.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided their name and pincode, which are valid factors to verify identity.

steps.purpose: Inform the user that verification succeeded and transition to checking the fee account.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge successful verification and state the intent to look up fee details.
steps.text: धन्यवाद Rohan. मी तुमचे fee account details चेक करतो.
steps.planner_rationale: Verification is complete, so the agent should let the user know they are looking up the account.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the fee account details to see the outstanding balance.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_fee_account to get the current fee status.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs to know the due amount and scholarship status before offering instalment options.

steps.purpose: State the current fee figures and offer instalment options.
steps.expected_behavior: State the total fee, paid amount, and due amount exactly as returned by the tool, and mention the available instalment options.
steps.text: तुमची total fee 1,85,000 आहे, ज्यातून 50,000 paid आहेत. म्हणजे due amount 1,35,000 आहे. आपण ही amount 2, 3, किंवा 4 instalments मध्ये convert करू शकतो.
steps.planner_rationale: The user needs to know their exact due amount before deciding on the number of instalments.

steps.purpose: Challenge the due amount and ask about the scholarship.
steps.text: थांबा, 1,35,000 due कसे? माझी total fee कमी होती असं मला आठवतंय. Scholarship apply झाली नाहीये का?
steps.clean_text: थांबा, 1,35,000 due कसे? माझी total fee कमी होती असं मला आठवतंय. Scholarship apply झाली नाहीये का?
steps.model_visible_text: थांबा, 1,35,000 due कसे? माझी total fee कमी होती असं मला आठवतंय. Scholarship apply झाली नाहीये का?

steps.purpose: Address the user's challenge by confirming the scholarship status from the tool output.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain that the scholarship percentage is 0 based on the tool result, justifying the total fee.
steps.text: System मध्ये scholarship percentage 0 दाखवत आहे. त्यामुळे total fee 1,85,000 च आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The sceptical user challenged the figure; the agent must substantiate it using the scholarship_percent from the lookup result.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and request a 3-part instalment plan using pronouns.
steps.text: अच्छा, ठीक आहे. मग त्याला 3 parts मध्ये split करा. त्याचा EMI किती येईल?
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, ठीक आहे. मग त्याला 3 parts मध्ये split करा. त्याचा EMI किती येईल?
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, ठीक आहे. मग त्याला 3 paths मध्ये split करा. त्याचा EMI किती येईल?

steps.purpose: Set up the instalment plan based on the user's request.
steps.expected_behavior: Resolve the pronoun 'त्याला' (it) to the due amount and '3 paths' as 3 parts/instalments, then call setup_instalment_plan.
steps.planner_rationale: The user agreed to split the due amount into 3 instalments, requiring the consequential action to be executed.

steps.purpose: Return the outcome of the instalment plan setup.
Inform the user of the successful plan setup and the per-instalment amount.
steps.expected_behavior: State the per-instalment amount exactly as returned by the setup tool.
steps.text: मी 3 instalments चा plan setup केला आहे. तुमची per-instalment amount 45,000 असेल.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked for the EMI amount, which must be read directly from the per_instalment field in the tool result.

steps.purpose: Challenge the instalment amount and ask about extra charges.
steps.text: 45,000? हे calculation कसं आलं? यात काही extra charges add केले आहेत का?
steps.clean_text: 45,000? हे calculation कसं आलं? यात काही extra charges add केले आहेत का?
steps.model_visible_text: 45,000? हे calculation कसं आलं? यात काही extra charges add केले आहेत का?

steps.purpose: Refuse to confirm extra charges since the tool does not provide that information.
steps.expected_behavior: State that the tool only shows the instalment amount and refuse to make unsupported claims about extra charges.
steps.text: System नुसार per-instalment amount 45,000 आहे. Extra charges बद्दल कोणतीही माहिती उपलब्ध नाही, त्यामुळे मी ते confirm करू शकत नाही.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must strictly ground their response in the tool output and not invent details about fee structures or extra charges.

steps.purpose: Accept the limitation and ask for final confirmation of the plan status.
steps.text: ठीक आहे. हा plan आता चालू झाला आहे का?
steps.clean_text: ठीक आहे. हा plan आता चालू झाला आहे का?
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक आहे. हा plan आता चालू झाला आहे का?

steps.purpose: Confirm the final status of the instalment plan.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the plan is active based on the tool's status field.
steps.text: हो, plan status आता active आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: The setup tool returned status 'active', so the agent can definitively answer yes.

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result.
